identitySignals: OUSD's Labor & Employee Relations page lists AFSCME (American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees) as one of six bargaining units, matching the agenda's collective bargaining agreement.

AFSCME Council 57 (Oakland, CA) has a local, Local 257, that represents OUSD employees; the agenda says 'Local 57', which does not exactly match any local found (possibly a shorthand or typo for Council 57 / Local 257).
research.notes: Not confirmed. The agenda names 'Local 57', but the OUSD-representing local found is AFSCME Local 257 under Council 57. No exact 'Local 57' registry entry was found and the contract page is login-gated, so the match cannot be verified. Do not publish without human review.

profile.summary: AFSCME Local 257 is a labor union local affiliated with AFSCME Council 57 in Northern California. It represents Oakland Unified School District employees such as custodians, food service workers, licensed vocational nurses and paraeducators.
